facts.fact: The Agence de Modernisation des Villes says its Niamey addressing geoportal, built by GéoMinds Africa with city-validated data, references 3,500+ streets of the capital, to modernise the traditional addressing system.

NER.note: The page describes a street-addressing geoportal and states no administrative-data statistics.
The page states no connection at a local government office; the geoportal is a web service and the city only supplies and validates data.
